title: [v0.32.0rc] [Performance] Optimize QLI Top-K merge width and vector dispatch
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Optimize QuantLightningIndexer (QLI) on `releases/v0.32.0rc`, based on [jj_tang/ops-transformer, experimental_split_mode](https://gitcode.com/jj_tang/ops-transformer/tree/experimental_split_mode).

- Align the token Top-K working width to 64 and size UB accumulators and LD merge buffers accordingly, reducing sorting, merging, copying and extraction work. Update the corresponding LD workspace indexing/strides while keeping the candidate-block Top-K accumulator independent.
- Batch candidate-score and integer mask/pinning vector operations with AscendC Level-0 `mask + repeatTimes`, with up to 255 full repeats, exact masked tails and retained vector barriers. This implementation comes from `experimental/attention/quant_lightning_indexer_v2/op_kernel/arch22` at source commit [66ae55e085d109f248fccc96e2c8cb9820316d20](https://gitcode.com/jj_tang/ops-transformer/tree/66ae55e085d109f248fccc96e2c8cb9820316d20); credit to jj_tang.
- Preserve the integrated QLI v3 candidate modes, public schema, int64 K-scale addressing and integer `Adds(+0)` merge copy.

The two kernel headers and operator tests match the reviewed main implementation exactly after line-ending normalization. The release-branch patch contains no unrelated main commits. Base: `ffca1c99bb28d9c92dd5dcf327f8b242404a5055`.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Reduce QLI Top-K merge work and vector dispatch overhead for DeepSeek-V4.1 on Ascend A3. Public APIs and configuration remain unchanged.

### How was this patch tested?

- Retain the 72 CPU-reference candidate/strided-cache cases and 30 adaptive Top-K boundary cases (102 new cases). Both new test entry points have explicit A2/A3 guards, including mode-3 controls, so A5/other devices skip the arch22 coverage.
- Consolidate the cases with existing coverage in `test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2.py`.
- Static parity with the reviewed main implementation, Python syntax, applicable Ruff/format/lint checks, direct long-function/meta checks and `git diff --check` passed.
- Full local formatting checks remain incomplete: actionlint's Go dependency download timed out; Windows-dependent shell/PNG and other unavailable hooks were excluded from the applicable-check run. CI is required.
- **Historical hardware evidence for the same optimization implementation, not a new release-branch run:** native build/install and 102/102 reference cases passed on Ascend A3, CANN 9.2.0, torch 2.10.0+cpu and torch_npu 2.10.0.post7. Three trials per state in A1-B1-B2-A2-A3-B3 order, 500 warmups and 100 NPU-event samples per case/run: 12 stable consumer cases reduced latency by 21.79%–30.69%; 10 stable source cases by 8.73%–9.67%. Two short source cases remain inconclusive due to timing variance; disabled controls were within noise.
- The rc branch has **not** been rebuilt or rerun on NPU for this backport. Release-branch native build, NPU correctness, ACL graph and model-level validation remain pending. Historical operator timings do not establish release-branch or model throughput gains.

```bash
pytest -q tests/e2e/nightly/single_node/ops/singlecard_ops/test_quant_lightning_indexer_v2.py
```

- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/544f182d9f0c9bfe8bd7645525951d5e3692a542
